column1: What is a plane algebraic curve?
column2: The zero set \( \{(x, y) : F(x, y) = 0\} \) of a polynomial \( F \). Its degree is the degree of \( F \).

column1: How does \( B^2 - 4AC \) classify a conic?
column2: Negative: ellipse. Zero: parabola. Positive: hyperbola (or a degenerate pair of lines).

column1: Rational parametrization of the unit circle?
column2: \( \left( \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}, \frac{2t}{1 + t^2} \right) \): the second point on the line of slope \( t \) through \( (-1, 0) \).

column1: What is a singular point of \( F = 0 \)?
column2: A point where \( F \), \( F_x \) and \( F_y \) all vanish: a node (self-crossing) or a cusp (sharp point).

column1: Why does a tangent line count as meeting a circle twice?
column2: Substitution gives a quadratic with a double root. Counted with multiplicity, a line always meets a conic twice.

Projective plane curves of degrees \( m \) and \( n \) with no common piece meet in \( mn \) points, counted with multiplicity over \( \mathbb{C} \).

column1: Weierstrass form of an elliptic curve and smoothness test?
column2: \( y^2 = x^3 + ax + b \), smooth exactly when \( 4a^3 + 27b^2 \ne 0 \).

column1: What shape are the complex points of an elliptic curve?
column2: A torus (genus 1). Genus of a smooth degree-\( d \) curve: \( (d-1)(d-2)/2 \).

column1: Addition formulas on \( y^2 = x^3 + ax + b \)?
column2: \( x_3 = \lambda^2 - x_1 - x_2 \), \( y_3 = \lambda(x_1 - x_3) - y_1 \), with \( \lambda \) the chord slope or \( (3x_1^2 + a)/(2y_1) \) for doubling.

column1: What is the zero of the elliptic curve group?
column2: The point at infinity \( O \). \( P + (-P) = O \), where \( -P \) is the reflection of \( P \).

column1: Why is elliptic curve cryptography secure?
column2: Computing \( kG \) is fast (double-and-add). Recovering \( k \) from \( kG \) (the discrete log) has no known fast method.
